item.title: New Construction Planned for Pocconock Trail
item.description: The municipal Building Department on Feb. 13 received an application for a 5,380-square-foot house in southeastern New Canaan. The six-bedroom home planned for 15 Pocconock Trail will include six full bathrooms, one half-bath, three fireplaces, finished basement and attic and a three-bay garage. It will cost about $1,150,000, the building permit application said. The contractor […]

item.title: Town Approves Contract for Improving Route 106/Farm Road Intersection
item.description: Municipal officials on Tuesday approved a $14,500 contract with a New Haven-based engineering firm to advance the town’s plans for fixing a major traffic problem in New Canaan.
